primitives.verbatim_quote: At the moment of the Tuesday seal, the engine serializes team ratings, the scheme interchangeability cost matrix , the inverse-MDP fourth-down risk preference , and the Sealed EPA Dropoff Table into a canonical 64-character SHA-256 digest (coachMindsetHash)3.
primitives.assumptions: Model state is fixed at Tuesday seal; all mid-week updates preserve this hash.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Byte-level invariance under injury designation updates.

The core architecture operates under a strict epistemic boundary: all predictive and policy components originate from a Tuesday-sealed baseline. The coachMindsetHash ensures immutability of foundational elements such as team ratings and EPA dropoffs. Mid-week adjustments are constrained to entropy-regularized optimal transport, which allows for dynamic reweighting of execution strategies without mutating the core model state. This preserves the integrity of the system’s internal logic. External market data enters only post-seal, where it is de-vigged and evaluated using finite-sample split conformal prediction. This method ensures that any deviation from the sealed model's expectations triggers a diagnostic flag, preventing contamination of the model’s internal state. The use of conformal prediction provides distribution-free uncertainty quantification, ensuring robustness even under adversarial or non-standard market conditions. The failure mode occurs when an external signal violates the symmetric prediction interval, necessitating operator intervention without altering the sealed model.
